signals.name: Intel Corporation

signals.detail: Nancy Pelosi's household disclosed INTC call-option purchases (strike $50, expiring 19 Mar 2027) in the same late-July filing as its large Bloom Energy bet; the U.S. government's 9.9% equity stake (from the 2025 CHIPS/DoD conversion) had an unrealized paper gain of roughly $36B as of mid-September 2026. Separately, Intel was named among the week's (14-18 Sep) most talked-about stocks by investors in a Benzinga roundup alongside Apple and Nvidia.
signals.takeaway: A high-profile congressional options bet on Intel lines up with a pickup in broader investor chatter the same week, worth watching for follow-through.

Cleo Fields (D-LA) disclosed another AAPL purchase in mid-August 2026, part of a pattern of roughly 19+ buys since 2025 with no sales, continuing even after Tim Cook's CEO-exit news; Apple was separately named among the week's (14-18 Sep) most-buzzed stocks by investors in the same Benzinga roundup alongside Nvidia and Intel.
signals.takeaway: A congressman keeps averaging up regardless of the CEO transition headline, and broader investor attention on Apple was elevated the same week.

signals.name: Advanced Micro Devices
signals.label: Hedge fund buying + split retail buzz
signals.detail: Q2 2026 13F filings show Tiger Global opening a new ~$392M stake and Citadel, Whale Rock Capital, Maverick Capital and Soros Fund Management all adding to AMD, even as other funds fully exited the name the same quarter. AMD is simultaneously one of the most-mentioned tickers on r/wallstreetbets this week, though Reddit sentiment reads roughly split (45% bullish/55% bearish) rather than clearly positive.
signals.takeaway: Institutional money is accumulating AMD while retail chatter is heavy but split, so read it as a smart-money-led setup rather than a retail-driven one.

signals.name: Nvidia Corp
signals.label: Congress + retail buzz, but insiders selling
signals.detail: Rep. Gil Cisneros (D-CA) disclosed an NVDA purchase in a Sept batch filing that also included Microsoft and Palantir (itself flagged for late STOCK Act disclosure), and NVDA ranks among the most-mentioned, bullish-skewing tickers on Reddit trackers this week -- but this runs counter to Nvidia insiders, who have been large net sellers (director Mark Stevens sold ~$235.6M on 3 Sep 2026).
signals.takeaway: Buy-side attention from Congress and retail is elevated, but heavy insider selling is a real counter-signal worth weighing before following the crowd.

signals.name: GameStop Corp
signals.label: CEO buying + retail buzz
signals.detail: Chairman/CEO Ryan Cohen made a discretionary (non-10b5-1) purchase of 1,000,000 Class A shares for ~$20.4M on 10 Sep 2026 per SEC Form 4, and GME remains one of the highest-volume tickers on Reddit trackers this week, though sentiment readings are polarized rather than cleanly bullish.
signals.takeaway: Insider conviction from the top is real and large, but retail attention is loud and divided, so expect volatility rather than a clean trend.

signals.name: Pan American Silver Corp.
signals.label: Silver mania continues, analyst estimates rising fast
signals.detail: PAAS is benefiting from the ongoing silver price rally and its recent MAG Silver acquisition; the Zacks consensus 2026 EPS estimate has risen 30.1% over the past 60 days (2027 estimates up 34.9%), after a prior 5-day rally sent the stock up 26% into the $48-$50 range as of Sept 17-18, 2026.
signals.takeaway: Analyst estimate revisions of this magnitude in under two months show the silver retail/institutional convergence is intensifying, not fading.

signals.name: CoreWeave, Inc.
signals.label: Dilution-driven selloff collides with AI-demand fundamentals
signals.detail: On 2026-09-17 CoreWeave announced a $3B private placement of convertible senior notes due 2033 (plus a $500M option) alongside a new equity distribution facility for up to 35M shares; shares fell as much as 7% (~$90 to ~$78) on dilution concerns, even after Q2 2026 results of $2.575B revenue and 90.6% gross margin.
signals.takeaway: Strong underlying AI-compute demand is colliding with capital-raise-driven investor anxiety, making this a genuine smart-money-vs-jittery-retail split.

signals.name: SanDisk Corporation
signals.label: S&P 100 inclusion + doubled hedge-fund stakes vs. heavy insider selling
signals.detail: SNDK jumped over 11% on 2026-09-18 (after +6% the prior day) ahead of joining the S&P 100 on 2026-09-21; hedge-fund ownership has more than doubled recently (institutional ownership 76.79%) and it's the #3 trending WSB ticker (132 mentions, +389% w/w), even as insiders sold $77.3M over the trailing 12 months, including the CEO's $51.7M sale on 2026-09-17.
signals.takeaway: An index-inclusion-driven institutional and retail stampede is colliding with unusually heavy C-suite selling on a stock up 574% in 2026 -- a yellow flag worth watching.
